text:
No satellite thermal detections were found at this asset (ASSET-F08, rural property) between 4 October and 3 November 2026. NASA FIRMS data from VIIRS (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) and MODIS covered every day of that period, and none of the detections intersected the asset boundary.

This does not prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The result also says nothing about burned area, since that was not assessed. It does not identify the cause of any change on the ground, and it says nothing about dates outside the 30-day window.

So there is no thermal evidence of fire in this period, but if you need confirmation, a burned-area analysis or imagery review would be the next step. The evidence is current as of 12 November 2026.
